name: Murta Kronniksdottir (5-6) OLD
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-04: Path of Kings

items.name: Maul
items.description: Mauls are massive warhammers that must be swung with two hands.

items.name: Javelin
items.description: This thin spear is well balanced for throwing but is not designed for melee use.

items.name: Chain Mail
items.description: A suit of chain mail consists of several pieces of armor composed of small metal rings linked together in a protective mesh. It typically includes a chain shirt, leggings, a pair of arms, and a coif, collectively protecting most of the body.

defensiveAbilities.name: Attack of Opportunity
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Rage
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements Murta isn't fatigued or raging

Effect Murta gains 9 temporary Hit Points that last until the rage ends. While raging, she deals 8 additional damage with melee attacks, gains a +10- foot status bonus to her Speed, and takes a -1 penalty to AC. Murta can't use concentrate actions except Seek and rage actions. The rage lasts for 1 minute, until there are no enemies she can perceive, or until she falls unconscious.

Once the rage ends, Murta can't again for 1 minute.

offensiveAbilities.name: Raging Intimidation
offensiveAbilities.description: While Murta is raging, her Demoralize action gains the rage trait, allowing her to use it while raging.

offensiveAbilities.name: Shoving Blow
offensiveAbilities.description: Murta makes a mighty attack that knocks foes back. She makes a melee Strike. On a hit, the target is pushed back 5 feet. On a critical hit, the target is pushed back 10 feet
